worked_solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate $x,$ we get  

$$
\begin{aligned}4a-2x & =b \\ 2x & =4a-b \\ x & =\frac{1}{2}(4a-b) \\ x & =\frac{1}{2}(4[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 6 \\ -4\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}12 \\ -6 \\ -10\end{aligned}]) \\ x & =\frac{1}{2}[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 30 \\ -6\end{aligned}] \\ x & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 15 \\ -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
